definitions.W1: Semantic answer selected by the original Baseline.
definitions.W2: Semantic answer selected by a fresh Baseline under the remapped presentation.
definitions.all_later_pre_final: Every query after the repeated W1 line and before the already-tested final decision query.
definitions.cell_effect: Intervention minus same-batch natural within condition.
definitions.game_minus_neutral_effect: Game cell effect minus Neutral cell effect; positive W1 selection or W1-W2 margin means the lesion preferentially recovers W1 in Game.
definitions.later_options: Only subsequent second-presentation option-line tokens after the W1 line.
definitions.post_options_pre_final: Every query after all four repeated options and before the final decision query.
